claim: Patchline ships a cross-organization federated analysis that shares hazards without sharing source. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the federated claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make federated-cross-org-analysis-gate`.
